outcome: Stop intermittent browser-suite CI timeouts caused by single-threaded local test servers: an idle or preconnected browser socket blocks every later request for about 20 s. Start the Flask test server with make_server(..., threaded=True) in six Playwright suites (dark theme, Interview recovery/mobile nav, Interview review HTTP, Interview Studio operability, Journal frontend, Resume media), lock the Resume media synthetic stores and one-shot hooks for concurrent requests, and add one browser-free regression test proving an idle open connection does not stall a page load plus a guard that test servers stay threaded. Test-only: no runtime, CI configuration, deployment or product change.
